claim_boundaries: Mean gains do not imply calibrated envelopes. Measure/replay coverage and preserve calibration provenance without importing it as an undeclared mean veto.
API derivatives and finite-difference agreement do not establish physical Jacobian accuracy.
Immutable update semantics do not establish improved future errors or safe live controller swaps.
Synthetic absolute caps are regression safeguards, not simulator or arbitrary-system readiness.
Available Crazyflow truth remains conditional; failed collection is visible and not a model gain.

Overall scores must be finite/nonnegative. No missing, repeated or truncated case/regime/horizon roster.

Reconstruct its original384 prefix and fixed development cache from the new unchanged input collection before each fit. Candidate876-window norms are separate model internals, never the required scoring denominator.

evidence_roster.public_end_to_end: Exactly one candidate public fit per simulator from unchanged96 admitted calibration recordings using automatic roles. Under the pinned CPU runtime require byte-identical ordered train1536/dev256 cache arrays/sidecars, actual initial and selected parameter/norm arrays, hold scales and fixed channel weights against authenticated expanded research evidence, plus exact array rosters/dtypes/shapes, roles/window identities, ridge scalar and selected checkpoint step. Prediction/AD/reduction comparisons use their separately frozen tolerances. Saved-model port parity alone is insufficient. Fresh common tests use the frozen generation/query/metric/aggregation definitions.

replay.requirement: Recompute saved physics truth, selected mean predictions, metrics and decision without refitting. Historical references run in their original pinned subprocess.

Implement and commit the single maintained public recipe, qualification runner and Dart-owned consumer; run fixed unit/regression tests.
Validate saved-mean and preparation parity plus fixed numerical and lifecycle fixtures.
Generate the fixed new test cohort and unchanged synthetic data; execute exactly the declared public scientific fits, recording failures and actual budgets.
Evaluate all frozen physical/synthetic/precision/coverage queries; run independently launched Dart consumer on its input-only roster.
Seal artifacts, reproduce physics/predictions/calibration/metrics/decision without refitting, complete bounded12-case alteration audit and fixed-denominator substitution check.
Apply the frozen public-mean promotion conjunction, record results/limits and update status; integrate only supported changes.

fit_and_work_budget.attempts: One fit per declared case per committed implementation attempt. No automatic restart or alternate seed/cache/precision after failure. Preserve every failed attempt and compute spent. A correction that restores the same frozen recipe may be tested and explicitly rerun with both attempts retained; a changed mechanism/data/threshold requires a new frozen iteration.
fit_and_work_budget.existing_regressions: Existing public-interface/IO/CLI toy tests may execute their fixed test fixtures; record test duration and distinguish those calls from the32 qualification fits. They do not select a recipe/checkpoint or replace full-budget qualification. Reuse new lifecycle artifacts for its negative/precision/archive checks rather than refitting per check.
fit_and_work_budget.per_fit: 1000 proposals, full actualN cache, maximum8001 acceptance objectives; fixed initialization/weights/selector/learning rate/seed. Flight N1536, synthetic N876, lifecycle N3/N6/N3.
fit_and_work_budget.work_accounting: Count actual entered/returned/completed gradients and full-objective calls, actualN window visits, accepted/rejected proposals, selected step, compile/prepare/fit/calibration times and native peak RSS scope. No equal-compute claim versus old public384/minibatch64.

decision.integrity: All planned query identities and truth masks must agree across arms; every eligible prediction finite; retain unavailable truth and failed collection.
decision.meaning: Prospective engineering margins for port retention and public promotion, not universal adequacy thresholds, confidence claims or a permanent research-adoption rule.
decision.operators: Use the anchored expanded-cache resolved protocol physical floors, aggregation, scopes, groups, horizons, weights, paired bootstrap, parent quantiles and availability rules verbatim. Report every condition; no added per-cell win veto.
decision.primary_candidate: Public v4 ordinary default32 predictions from one fit64 per simulator
decision.references: Authenticated saved v3 and expanded-research float64 predictions. Do not downcast reference parameters, inputs or predictions to improve candidate ratios.
decision.secondary: Public float64 prediction parity and physical/evidence diagnostics on identical queries. No second fit or alternative selected checkpoint.
decision.separate_claims: Coverage, update improvement, physical Jacobian fidelity and controller readiness remain separately reported and unqualified unless independently demonstrated.

vs_public_v3.other_gates: Only these two aggregate maxima plus integrity/finite/matched-query guards. Do not inherit undeclared per-simulator/scope/tail vetoes for this reference.

specification_precedence.anchors: Source inventories describe observed preimplementation sources. Preserve historical sources and use a frozen checkout/process. New maintained sources and new consumer/exporter hashes must be bound to a clean implementation commit before any trial.
specification_precedence.failures: A contradiction in normative numerical requirements is a prefreeze review blocker. After freezing, preserve failures and do not silently reinterpret requirements.
specification_precedence.policy_input: The policy-input JSON is a source catalog for exact synthetic cases/generators/caps, original flags and existing test provenance. Its older suggested public toy fixture is not an extra lifecycle qualification stage; the linked lifecycle roster governs the three new lifecycle operations. Its older candidate-scaled acceptance suggestion is superseded by the fixed-reference synthetic scoring policy.
specification_precedence.rule: This outer protocol supplies final scope and acceptance. The numerical-port, numerical-parity, lifecycle, synthetic-scoring, consumer and alteration specifications are normative where linked. Their design-only headings describe preparation history, not optional gates. Future implementation hashes bind committed code before execution; no unspecified post-observation threshold choice is permitted.
